info.name: Career Sync API
info.description:
Complete, source-verified Postman collection for the Career Sync backend (Express + MongoDB, server/ directory). Generated directly from the route/controller/model/middleware source code as of 2026-09-03 (see POSTMAN_API_INVENTORY.md for the full endpoint audit and POSTMAN_TESTING_GUIDE.md for setup and workflow).

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:4000` (server/config/swagger.js and .env.example both confirm this as the dev default; override via the `baseUrl` variable if your server runs elsewhere).

**Authentication is cookie-based, not Bearer-token-based.** Login sets httpOnly, signed `accessToken`/`refreshToken`/`refreshTokenSecret` cookies; the JSON response body only ever contains `{ tokenUser: { name, userId, role } }` — there is no access/refresh token string to copy into a header. Postman's built-in cookie jar stores and resends these automatically for requests to the same `{{baseUrl}}`, so no manual wiring is required. The important consequence: the cookie jar holds ONE active session per domain, so switching between talent/employer/talent-2 requires re-running the matching 'Login - <role>' request — every folder below starts with the login(s) it needs.

**Variables:** all dynamic values (baseUrl, seed credentials, and IDs captured from responses via test scripts — talentUserId, employerUserId, jobId, applicationId, organizationId, verification tokens) live as collection variables so the whole collection works with or without a separate Postman Environment selected. A companion `career-sync.postman_environment.json` is provided for convenience/override.
